How Franklin Navigator keeps changing information accurate

  • Every time-sensitive item must show its source and when it was last checked.
  • Recurring language alone does not prove that an activity happens on a specific date.
  • Conflicting official times stay suppressed until resolved.
  • Youth and school discovery exposes no child or student data.
  • Alcohol-related routes never imply safe consumption, age eligibility or transportation.
  • Sponsored placement, sales ranking, outreach, reservations and purchases remain separate from local research truth.

Source inventory observed August 27, 2026. Verify all changing information before relying on it.
